title: Subtitles
setup_needed: Whisper runtime and model download automatically on first transcription (or in AI Center). ~250 MB total.
whisper_missing: Whisper is not installed — see AI Center.
burn_hint: Burning embeds subtitles permanently into the picture (MP4, audio copied). Edit text in the bottom panel.
no_segments: No segments — run transcription and subtitles will appear here.
model_hint: Bigger model = more accurate, but slower. For Slovak use small or medium.
